2607.07330.title: Hypergraph Neural Stochastic Diffusion: An SDE Framework for Uncertainty Estimation
2607.07330.paper_summary: Hypergraph neural networks have shown powerful capability in modeling higher-order relations, yet their predictive uncertainty remains underexplored. Unlike pairwise graphs, uncertainty in hypergraphs arises not only from noisy attributes and ambiguous labels, but also from variations in node-hyperedge incidence structures and complex higher-order dependencies. Existing approaches mainly estimate uncertainty from final predictions or rely on computationally expensive ensembles and Bayesian inference, limiting their ability to capture uncertainty evolution during representation learning. In this paper, we propose Hypergraph Neural Stochastic Diffusion(HyperNSD), a stochastic differential equation framework for uncertainty estimation on hypergraphs. HyperNSD models hypergraph representations as stochastic processes evolving over node-hyperedge incidence structures. A learnable drift function captures deterministic higher-order diffusion dynamics, while a learnable stochastic forcing function characterizes structural ambiguity and representation noise. Predictive uncertainty is directly quantified through the variability of stochastic representation trajectories, providing an intrinsic uncertainty measure beyond post-hoc confidence scores. We formulate HyperNSD with neural drift and diffusion networks, enabling joint learning of prediction and uncertainty propagation. Theoretical analyses establish well posedness, perturbation stability,permutation equivariance, and numerical convergence of the proposed stochastic dynamics. Experiments on multiple hypergraph benchmarks demonstrate that HyperNSD achieves reliable uncertainty estimation for out-of-distribution and misclassification detection while preserving competitive prediction accuracy. These results provide a principled stochastic-dynamical framework for trustworthy higher-order representation learning.
2607.07330.paper_summary_zh: 超圖神經網絡在建模高階關係方面展現出強大的能力，但其預測不確定性仍然未被充分探索。與成對圖不同，超圖中的不確定性不僅來自於嘈雜的屬性和模糊的標籤，還來自於節點-超邊發生結構的變化和複雜的高階依賴關係。現有的方法主要從最終預測中估計不確定性，或依賴計算成本高昂的集成和貝葉斯推斷，這限制了它們在表示學習過程中捕捉不確定性演變的能力。在本文中，我們提出了超圖神經隨機擴散（HyperNSD），這是一個用於超圖不確定性估計的隨機微分方程框架。HyperNSD將超圖表示建模為在節點-超邊發生結構上演變的隨機過程。一個可學習的漂移函數捕捉確定性的高階擴散動力學，而一個可學習的隨機強迫函數則表徵結構模糊性和表示噪聲。預測不確定性通過隨機表示軌跡的變異性直接量化，提供了一種超越事後置信分數的內在不確定性度量。我們用神經漂移和擴散網絡來公式化HyperNSD，實現預測和不確定性傳播的聯合學習。理論分析確立了所提出的隨機動力學的良好適定性、擾動穩定性、置換等變性和數值收斂性。在多個超圖基準上的實驗表明，HyperNSD在保持競爭性預測準確性的同時，實現了對於分佈外和錯誤分類檢測的可靠不確定性估計。這些結果為值得信賴的高階表示學習提供了一個原則性的隨機動力學框架。
